summary: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report presents the results of staff's investigation for a request to have all-way stop controls installed at several intersections within the Richview Gardens Neighbourhood. The intersections studied were Wincott Drive and Strathdee Drive, Wincott Drive and Hartsdale Drive, Wincott Drive and Sheffley Crescent, and Hartsdale Drive and Holgate Street. The request was made by the area councillor as a result of concerns raised by several area residents. A staff assessment has determined that the installation of all-way stop controls are not warranted or recommended at any of the aforementioned intersections.
decided: Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of all-way stop controls at the intersection of Wincott Drive and Strathdee Drive. 2. Did not approve the installation of all-way stop controls at the intersection of Wincott Drive and Hartsdale Drive. 3. Did not approve the installation of all-way stop controls at the intersection of Wincott Drive and Sheffley Crescent. 4. Approved the installation of all-way stop controls at the intersection of Hartsdale Drive and Holgate Street.
